utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Hello there! How was your day?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Hey Grandpa! My day was pretty good, just busy with schoolwork.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Ah, I see. Well, once you get it, you'll have more freedom to go places. Do you need any help with the process?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandpa! I think I'm good for now, but I'll let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I'm sorry if I made you feel that way. I didn't mean to group you with anyone else. You're doing great, and I'm here to help you.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No worries, Grandpa. I know you didn't mean it that way. I appreciate your support.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: No, you're not scaring me at all. I'm just here to support you.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandpa. I really appreciate you being there for me.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: No, you're not scaring me at all. I'm just here to support you.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm glad we understand each other. It's nice to have your support.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: You're doing really well for your first time. Keep it up!

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Thanks, Grandpa! That means a lot to me.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I'm glad to hear that. If you need any advice or help, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I will, Grandpa. Thanks for always being there for me.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Sounds like you're having a good time with the trucks. What do you like most about driving them?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I love the freedom it gives me, and it's exciting to explore new places.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Robbie's truck must be quite impressive. Do you enjoy driving it more than your own?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, it's a great truck, but I think I still prefer mine because I'm more used to it.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: It sounds like you have quite a few friends with trucks. Do you all go on adventures together?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, we do! It's always fun to hit the road and see where we end up.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yes, right here. We can talk about it or plan something fun with your friends and their trucks.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That sounds awesome! Maybe we can plan a camping trip or something.
